name: selfjev-4b
release: vision (images v1), 2026-09-30: the default since then; the text-only release is Jwuthrich/selfjev-4b
recipe: selfjev-4b (Jwuthrich/selfjev-4b) + selfjev finetune --lr 5e-5 --soft-weight 0.5 --max-length 16384, 1 epoch, 622 steps: 11,344 image questions from 6 licence-safe Hugging Face datasets (scripts/data/build_images_v1.py) + 11,344 text questions replayed from selfjev-4b's own training rows with Jev's probabilities as half-weight soft targets. The Qwen3.5 vision tower is frozen and unchanged; the LoRA (r64, attention + DeltaNet projections) is the only trained part.
inputs: text, JSON, an image (base64 data URL) or a list of text and image parts
